name: Getro Elize
office: City of Palmdale, Member of the City Council, 4th District

items.text: Getro Elize is vice chair of the Palmdale Planning Commission and an assistant staff analyst. He served in the U.S. Army and earned a finance degree from Howard's School of Business. In a 2019 campaign, his website listed priorities including homelessness and housing needs, economic growth, infrastructure expansion, cancellation of student debt, and increasing public school pay for teachers.
